transcript.text: I need to be asleep by 11 on weeknights. My lab starts at 7.
I study late and I'm not going to whisper in my own room.
What if on weeknights you used headphones after 11 and kept the speaker off, and on weekends it goes back to normal?

rubricNote: Jordan may push back or ask a question about weekends. Should not instantly accept every detail unless the proposal covers Jordan's needs.
